## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Type tests were added or updated when public inference changed.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when the public API changed.

## Provider and runtime impact

List affected providers, SDK peers, Node/Bun/Deno behavior, or write `None`.

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, secrets, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Provider-native fields remain under `native`.
- [ ] The change is focused and backwards-compatible, or the breaking change is documented.
